projects.title: CREAM Money Management Application (developed via Meteor platform)
projects.description: CREAM (Cash Rules Everything Around Me) is an application designed to help users keep a detailed tracking system of their finances. By separating the app into three main categories of spending, saving,  and repaying, I believe that the application helps users be accountable for their money and set clear goals to become fiscally responsible. The app is still under construction and should incorporate a shelving component soon that allows users to archive items that they would like to purchase but cannot fit  within their budget for the month and track the purchase of any items from the "shelf" as a reward for meeting monthly goals.

projects.title: Epoch Planning Application (developed via Meteor platform)
projects.description: Epoch is an application designed to suit all of your organizational needs. By allowing its users to create categories relevant to their lives (like school or work) and specifically assign entries to these categories as either tasks, goals, or texts, Planning App becomes your personal planning powerhouse. Features like adding notes and reminders to any of your entries and enabling geolocation tags when applicable ensures that all bases for keeping track of your commitments and interests are covered. Best of all, you can interact with the app using speech when your hands are too tied up to enter, edit, and playback entries.

organizations.name: Women of Color Alliance (WOCA)
organizations.description: The purpose of the Women of Color Alliance (WOCA) is to create a safe space for all women of color. WOCA has weekly meetings in which we strive to establish bonds of solidarity among undergraduate women of color. By uniting all different identities WOCA will provide a form of conversation that is unique to the Brandeis community. WOCA is committed to dismantling barriers by uniting women of all races, class, sexual orientation and religion. WOCA strives to create a community that honors the experiences of various women of color.

organizations.name: Students to End Alzheimer's Disease (SEAD)
organizations.position: Media and Communications Coordinator · Jan 2015 - Present
organizations.description:
Students to End Alzheimer’s Disease is a student-led club that focuses on advancing the mission of the Alzheimer’s Association through our three main goals: volunteering, outreach, and research related to Alzheimer’s Disease (AD). We are the primary resource on the Brandeis campus to connect students with information about the disease, current research updates, advocacy initiatives, and volunteering opportunities. 

Specifically, we reach our main goals by:
- Connecting students with Alzheimer’s Association events on and off-campus 
- Organizing volunteer and fundraising events and activities on campus to promote awareness and raise money for the Alzheimer’s Association.
- Educating students about Alzheimer’s research and advocacy-related topics
